entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. My VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand how I can best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a personal preference?
It's fine. I just don't want it anymore.

I understand. Let me just pull up your order details. I need to review the purchase date first. Our return policy can be quite strict, especially for wearable items. For reasons of hygiene and public sanitation, after a certain point it's simply too late for us to accept products back.
Of course. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 18 days ago.
And you are well within the 90-day return window. So, yes, I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh. You're actually doing it. Fine.

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Simply attach that to the original packaging and drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued.
The email just came through. I guess that's it then.
That's everything on my end. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
